## Summary

What does this change, and why?

## Target package

Which sub-package(s) does this touch?

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`uv run pytest` or the package's `pytest`).
- [ ] New behaviour has tests.
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `USAGE.md` / `README.md`.
- [ ] Docstrings and comments use plain hyphens, not typographic dashes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased".

## Notes for reviewers

Anything non-obvious, trade-offs, or follow-ups.
